## SQA Technical Knowledge Base & Taxonomy Series
- **Guide #41: Playwright storageState & Authentication Session Reuse**: Eliminates repeated UI logins in Playwright test suites via JSON storage state caching, reducing execution time by 70%.
- **Guide #42: Asynchronous Event & Message Queue Verification**: End-to-end messaging test architecture across RabbitMQ and Kafka validating at-least-once delivery, consumer idempotency, and Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) routing.
- **Guide #43: Persistence Layer & Database State Assertions in API Automation**: Direct SQL verification against relational test databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) pairing HTTP assertions with physical backend state.
- **Guide #44: Chaos Testing & Network Fault Injection with Playwright**: Intercepting network traffic and simulating degraded mobile connections (3G) or HTTP 503 gateway outages via `page.route` to verify graceful UI degradation.
- **Guide #45: Accessibility Automation with Axe-Core in Playwright CI Pipelines**: Automated WCAG 2.2 Level AA compliance verification inside pull request pipelines scanning rendered DOM trees for contrast ratios, ARIA contracts, and keyboard tab traps.
- **Guide #46: GraphQL API Automation and Query Depth Auditing**: Dynamic GraphQL mutation testing with Postman and Newman, coupled with automated security regression suites against query depth recursion limits and schema introspection vulnerabilities.
- **Guide #47: Observability-Driven QA and OpenTelemetry Trace Correlation**: Shift-right testing injecting W3C traceparent headers into Playwright automated tests to correlate client-side UI failures directly with backend microservice Jaeger traces.
- **Guide #48: Zero-Trust API Authentication and JWT Expiry Simulation**: Postman and Newman automated testing framework simulating short-lived access token lifecycles, automated refresh rotation, and RFC 6750 401 Unauthorized boundary handling.
- **Guide #49: Mutation Testing with Mutmut & Stryker for Test Suite Robustness**: Intentional injection of source code mutants to evaluate test assertion efficacy beyond superficial 100% code coverage in SQA automation.
- **Guide #50: Stateful Property-Based Testing with Hypothesis**: Generative test automation framework asserting universal mathematical/business invariants with automated failure shrinking to catch edge-case combinatorial defects.
- **Guide #51: Database Transaction Concurrency & Deadlock Testing**: Multi-threaded test harness in Pytest simulating parallel write operations to validate row-level locks, ACID isolation levels, and automated deadlock retry resilience.
- **Guide #52: Contract-Driven Microfrontends Testing with Webpack Module Federation**: Playwright automated verification of host-to-remote Module Federation interfaces, singleton shared dependency resolution, and graceful fallback error boundaries under remote outages.
- **Guide #53: WebSocket Real-Time Event & State Synchronization Testing**: Playwright duplex frame interception validating WebSocket JSON schemas, ping-pong keepalives, and automatic exponential backoff reconnection recovery.
- **Guide #54: Synthetic Production Monitoring with Playwright**: Shift-right automated QA executing recurring headless browser user journeys against production endpoints to enforce SLA timings and detect third-party service dropouts.
- **Guide #55: Compliance & Regulatory Testing (GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS)**: Risk-driven statutory verification covering immutable audit logs, PII data masking, Right to be Forgotten deletion protocols, and PCI-DSS payment tokenization.
- **Guide #56: Performance Test Types (Load, Stress, Spike, Soak)**: Decomposing enterprise performance engineering across baseline load, stress threshold limits, spike traffic surges, and 24-72 hour endurance soak testing.
- **Guide #57: Response Time & Latency SLAs (P90, P95, P99 Percentiles)**: Latency SLA verification in performance testing: why averages mislead engineering teams and how P95/P99 tail latencies pinpoint database pool contention.
- **Guide #58: 5 Core Principles of REST APIs in Backend SQA**: Technical evaluation of statelessness, client-server decoupling, cacheability contracts, and uniform interface boundaries in automated API testing.
- **Guide #59: Anatomy of an API Request in Backend QA**: Deconstructing HTTP method semantics, authentication bearer token headers, content-type negotiation, and URL query parameter boundary testing.
- **Guide #60: Multi-Tenant Data Isolation & Tenant-Leak Testing**: Cross-tenant penetration suites validating PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS), asserting 404 response boundaries against IDOR/BOLA attacks, and preventing Redis cache key cross-tenant pollution.
- **Guide #61: gRPC Service & Protocol Buffers Automation**: Automated testing of high-throughput gRPC services with pytest-grpc: asserting canonical StatusCode semantics and backward compatibility with buf breaking.
- **Guide #62: Mobile Web Touch Gesture & Viewport Emulation with Playwright**: Cross-device responsive test automation in Playwright: simulating touch events, deviceScaleFactor, viewport orientation shifts, and mobile CLS stability.

- **Guide #69: Distributed Tracing & Context Propagation in Microservice API Testing**: End-to-end observability testing in microservices: injecting W3C traceparent and baggage headers, correlating distributed spans with OpenTelemetry and Jaeger, validating microservice latency budgets, and enforcing downstream SLA gates in pytest.
- **Guide #70: Chaos Engineering & Network Latency Injection in QA Automation**: Full-stack resilience testing: simulating socket timeouts and TCP packet loss with Toxiproxy, verifying circuit breaker state transitions (closed, open, half-open), and asserting graceful browser fallbacks with Playwright route aborts.
- **Guide #71: Database Sharding & Read-Replica Lag Verification in Backend SQA**: Distributed data persistence QA: measuring PostgreSQL WAL replication lag, asserting read-after-write routing gates, testing eventual consistency thresholds, and validating uniform shard key distribution in pytest.
